reg_deadline.en: Registration closed on Sunday, October 4, 2026 online and on Monday, October 5 by mail. Not sure you're registered? Check MyscVOTES.
reg_deadline.es: El registro cerró el domingo 4 de octubre de 2026 en línea y el lunes 5 de octubre por correo. ¿No sabes si estás registrado? Revisa MyscVOTES.
reg_deadline.quote: Register online at scVOTES.gov (must be received by Sunday, October 4).

mail_request.en: Return your absentee application to your county voter registration office by 5 p.m. on Friday, October 23, 2026, by U.S. mail or in person. Applications can't be emailed or faxed.
mail_request.es: Entrega tu solicitud de voto en ausencia en la oficina de registro de votantes de tu condado (county voter registration office) a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del viernes 23 de octubre de 2026, por correo postal o en persona. Las solicitudes no se pueden enviar por correo electrónico ni por fax.
mail_request.quote: The deadline to return your application is 5:00 p.m. on Friday, October 23.
mail_request.en_after: Absentee applications closed at 5 p.m. on October 23. Admitted to a hospital as an emergency patient on Election Day or in the four days before? A member of your immediate family can still apply for a ballot and bring it to you. Otherwise, vote early in person through Saturday, October 31, or at your polling place on Election Day.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes de voto en ausencia cerraron a las 5 p. m. del 23 de octubre. ¿Te internaron en un hospital como paciente de emergencia el Día de las Elecciones o en los cuatro días antes? Un familiar directo todavía puede pedir una boleta y llevártela. Si no, vota por anticipado en persona hasta el sábado 31 de octubre, o en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones.
mail_request.notes: Hospital route: S.C. Code 7-15-330(D) (https://www.scstatehouse.gov/code/t07c015.php) 'if an elector is admitted to a hospital as an emergency patient on the day of an election or within a four-day period before the election, then a member of the elector's immediate family may obtain an application from the board on the day of an election, complete it, receive the ballot, deliver it personally to the patient who shall vote, and personally carry the ballot back'. Also on https://scvotes.gov/voters/absentee-voting/. Read 2026-10-28.

mail_return.en: Your county voter registration office must receive it by 7 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. A postmark isn't enough. Still have your ballot this week? The Election Commission says to consider bringing it in person, with your photo ID, to your county voter registration office, or to an early voting center through Saturday, October 31.
mail_return.es: La oficina de registro de votantes de tu condado debe recibirla a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre de 2026. El matasellos no basta. ¿Todavía tienes tu boleta esta semana? La Comisión Electoral recomienda considerar llevarla en persona, con tu identificación con foto, a la oficina de registro de votantes de tu condado, o a un centro de votación anticipada hasta el sábado 31 de octubre.
mail_return.quote: If you still have your ballot within a week prior to Election Day, consider returning the ballot in person.

early_hours.en: Early voting centers are open 8:30 a.m. to 6 p.m., Monday to Saturday, through Saturday, October 31. Use any early voting center in your county.
early_hours.es: Los centros de votación anticipada abren de 8:30 a. m. a 6 p. m., de lunes a sábado, hasta el sábado 31 de octubre. Puedes usar cualquier centro de votación anticipada de tu condado.
early_hours.quote: Early voting centers are open 8:30 a.m.- 6:00 p.m. (Monday-Saturday)
early_hours.en_after: Early voting ended Saturday, October 31. Vote at your polling place on Election Day, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m.
early_hours.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó el sábado 31 de octubre. Vota en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones, de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m.

cure.notes: No absentee cure process found on scvotes.gov.

in_person.en: Vote early at any early voting center in your county, no reason needed, with your photo ID. On Election Day, vote at the polling place for your precinct.
in_person.es: Vota por anticipado en cualquier centro de votación anticipada de tu condado, sin dar una razón, con tu identificación con foto. El Día de las Elecciones, vota en el lugar de votación de tu precinto.
in_person.quote: Any voter can vote early at any early voting center in their county during the early voting period.

first_time.en: Moved and didn't update your registration? If you moved within your precinct, update your address at your polling place and vote a regular ballot. If you moved to another precinct in your county, or to another county within 30 days of the election, go to your county voter registration office, change your address and vote a regular ballot there.
first_time.es: ¿Te mudaste y no actualizaste tu registro? Si te mudaste dentro de tu precinto, actualiza tu dirección en tu lugar de votación y vota con una boleta regular. Si te mudaste a otro precinto de tu condado, o a otro condado dentro de los 30 días antes de la elección, ve a la oficina de registro de votantes de tu condado, cambia tu dirección y vota ahí con una boleta regular.
first_time.quote: Go to the voter registration office in the county in which you currently reside, change your address, and vote a regular ballot there.

rule.en: Early voting is at any early voting center in your county. On Election Day, vote at the polling place for your precinct. Your polling place may have changed since your voter card was printed, so check MyscVOTES before you go.
rule.es: La votación anticipada es en cualquier centro de votación anticipada de tu condado. El Día de las Elecciones, vota en el lugar de votación de tu precinto. Puede que tu lugar de votación haya cambiado desde que se imprimió tu tarjeta de votante, así que revisa MyscVOTES antes de ir.
rule.quote: Always check your polling place at scVOTES.gov before leaving to vote.

en: South Carolina driver's license, standard or REAL ID
South Carolina DMV ID card, standard or REAL ID, including a Concealed Weapons Permit
South Carolina voter registration card with photo
Federal military ID, including Department of Defense photo IDs and the VA benefits card
es: Licencia de conducir de South Carolina, estándar o REAL ID
Tarjeta de identificación del DMV de South Carolina, estándar o REAL ID, incluido el permiso para portar armas ocultas (Concealed Weapons Permit)
Tarjeta de registro de votante de South Carolina con foto
Identificación militar federal, incluidas las identificaciones con foto del Departamento de Defensa y la tarjeta de beneficios de Asuntos de Veteranos (VA)
Pasaporte o tarjeta pasaporte de EE. UU.
accepted.quote: When voting in person, you will be asked to show one of the following current and valid Photo IDs:

expired.en: Your photo ID has to be current and valid. No ID? Registered voters can get a free photo voter registration card at the county voter registration office, even on Election Day.
expired.es: Tu identificación con foto debe estar vigente y ser válida. ¿No tienes? Si ya estás registrado, puedes sacar gratis una tarjeta de registro de votante con foto en la oficina de registro de votantes de tu condado, incluso el Día de las Elecciones.
expired.quote: If you are already registered to vote, you can go to your county voter registration and elections office, provide your date of birth and the last four digits of your Social Security Number, and have your photo taken.  You can do this even on Election Day.

without.en: Forgot your photo ID? Vote a provisional ballot, and show your ID at your county voter registration office before the election is certified. Can't get a photo ID? Bring your non-photo voter registration card, sign an affidavit saying why, and vote a provisional ballot that counts unless the affidavit is shown to be false.
without.es: ¿Se te olvidó tu identificación con foto? Vota con una boleta provisional y muestra tu identificación en la oficina de registro de votantes de tu condado antes de que se certifique la elección. ¿No puedes conseguir una identificación con foto? Lleva tu tarjeta de registro de votante sin foto, firma una declaración jurada que explique por qué, y vota con una boleta provisional que se cuenta salvo que se demuestre que la declaración es falsa.
without.quote: You may vote a provisional ballot that will count only if you show your Photo ID to the county voter registration and elections office prior to certification of the election (usually Thursday or Friday after the election).

who.en: You need a qualifying reason to vote absentee in South Carolina. You can if you:
who.es: Necesitas una razón válida para votar en ausencia en South Carolina. Puedes hacerlo si:
who.quote: Persons sixty-five years of age or older.

en: can't vote during early voting hours for the whole early voting period, or while polls are open on Election Day, because of work
are caring for someone sick or physically disabled and can't vote during early voting hours for the whole early voting period, or while polls are open on Election Day
will be out of your county for all of early voting and while polls are open on Election Day
are confined to a jail or pretrial facility pending disposition of an arrest or trial and can't vote during early voting or on Election Day
are in the U.S. Armed Forces or Merchant Marines, or their spouse or dependent living with them
are admitted to a hospital as an emergency patient on Election Day or within four days before it
es: no puedes votar en el horario de votación anticipada durante todo el periodo de votación anticipada, ni mientras están abiertos los lugares de votación el Día de las Elecciones, por tu trabajo

cuidas a una persona enferma o con discapacidad física y no puedes votar en el horario de votación anticipada durante todo ese periodo, ni mientras están abiertos los lugares de votación el Día de las Elecciones
vas a estar fuera de tu condado durante toda la votación anticipada y mientras estén abiertos los lugares de votación el Día de las Elecciones
estás en una cárcel o centro de detención preventiva mientras se resuelve un arresto o juicio, y no puedes votar por anticipado ni el Día de las Elecciones
estás en las Fuerzas Armadas o la Marina Mercante de EE. UU., o eres su cónyuge o dependiente económico y vives con esa persona
te internan en un hospital como paciente de emergencia el Día de las Elecciones o en los cuatro días antes
who_list.quote: Persons confined to a jail or pretrial facility pending disposition of arrest or trial which prevents them from voting during early voting hours for the duration of the early voting period, and during the hours the polls are open on election day.

witness.en: Sign the voter's oath on the return envelope and have someone 18 or older witness your signature. You don't need a notary.
witness.es: Firma el juramento del votante en el sobre de devolución y pide que una persona de 18 años o más sea testigo de tu firma. No necesitas notario.
witness.quote: Be sure to sign the voter’s oath and have your signature witnessed.  Anyone age 18 or older can witness your signature.  A notary is not necessary.

cure.en: Sign the oath and have it witnessed before you return your ballot. South Carolina can't count a ballot unless the oath is properly signed and witnessed.
cure.es: Firma el juramento y consigue la firma de un testigo antes de devolver tu boleta. Carolina del Sur no puede contar una boleta si el juramento no está bien firmado y atestiguado.
cure.quote: A ballot may not be counted unless the oath is properly signed and witnessed nor may any ballot be counted which is received by the county board of voter registration and elections after time for closing of the polls.

dropbox.en: Bring your ballot to your county voter registration office, or to an early voting center in your county during early voting, and show your photo ID. An immediate family member or authorized representative can return it for you in person with an Authorized Returnee form and photo ID. One person can return up to five ballots besides their own.
dropbox.es: Lleva tu boleta a la oficina de registro de votantes de tu condado, o a un centro de votación anticipada de tu condado durante la votación anticipada, y muestra tu identificación con foto. Un familiar directo o un representante autorizado puede devolverla por ti en persona, con el formulario Authorized Returnee y una identificación con foto. Una persona puede devolver hasta cinco boletas además de la suya.
dropbox.quote: Returnees are limited to five returns in addition to their own per election.

gear.en: No campaigning inside the polling place. Within 500 feet of an entrance, campaign literature, signs and posters aren't allowed.
gear.es: No se permite hacer campaña dentro del lugar de votación. A menos de 500 pies de una entrada no se permiten folletos, letreros ni carteles de campaña.
gear.quote: However, no campaign literature, signs, or posters are allowed.

phone.en: No photos or recordings inside a polling place, during early voting or on Election Day. State law also bars letting anyone see your ballot, and a 2012 Attorney General opinion says that covers copying it with a phone or camera. For a photo of an absentee ballot at home, we found no official guidance, so ask your county voter registration office.
phone.es: No se permiten fotos ni grabaciones dentro de un lugar de votación, ni en la votación anticipada ni el Día de las Elecciones. La ley estatal también prohíbe dejar que alguien vea tu boleta, y una opinión de la Fiscalía General (Attorney General) de 2012 dice que eso incluye copiarla con un celular o una cámara. Sobre fotos de una boleta de voto en ausencia en casa no encontramos ninguna guía oficial, así que pregunta a la oficina de registro de votantes de tu condado.
phone.quote: This poster clearly outlines that taking pictures or recordings inside polling places is strictly prohibited during both Early Voting and on Election Day.
phone.notes: 2026 Poll Manager Handbook, 'No Recording Devices Allowed Sign': 'In accordance with state law (§7-25-100), voters may not allow their ballot to be seen, remove a ballot from the polling place, use recording devices in the voting booth ... A South Carolina Attorney General Opinion (May 8, 2012) further confirms that this law prohibits reproducing a ballot using devices including, and not limited to, cell phones, cameras, tablets, or video equipment.' Read 2026-10-28.

line.en: Polls close at 7 p.m. If you're in line by then, stay put. You'll be allowed to vote.
line.es: Los lugares de votación cierran a las 7 p. m. Si estás en la fila a esa hora, no te salgas. Te dejarán votar.
line.quote: Polling places are open from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. on Election Day.  Anyone in line at 7:00 p.m. will be allowed to vote.

tradition.en: South Carolina's State Election Commission introduced two new statewide "I Voted" sticker designs for the 2022 elections, and they won a national Clearie Award from the U.S. Election Assistance Commission. Some counties add their own: Charleston County's 2026 stickers come from a student design contest.
tradition.es: La Comisión Electoral Estatal de South Carolina presentó dos nuevos diseños estatales de stickers de "I Voted" para las elecciones de 2022, y ganaron un premio nacional Clearie de la Comisión de Asistencia Electoral de EE. UU. (U.S. Election Assistance Commission). Algunos condados agregan los suyos: los stickers de 2026 del condado de Charleston salen de un concurso de diseño para estudiantes.
tradition.quote: The SEC’s new “I Voted” stickers also won a Clearie Award for exemplifying outreach and community flair.
tradition.notes: SEC release (posted May 23, 2023) on awards for the 2022 midterms. Design details (palmetto tree, state outline) are only on eac.gov, which is not an allowed source, so the page doesn't describe them. Whether those designs are still in use in 2026 is not confirmed.

early.en: In Charleston County, yes, for a limited time. Early voting centers and absentee voters get the 2026 student contest designs, by Emmeline (grades K to 5), Adalyn (6 to 8) and Katherine (9 to 12).
early.es: En el condado de Charleston, sí, por tiempo limitado. Los centros de votación anticipada y los votantes en ausencia reciben los diseños del concurso estudiantil de 2026, de Emmeline (kínder a 5.º grado), Adalyn (6.º a 8.º) y Katherine (9.º a 12.º).
early.quote: Winning designs will be distributed for a limited time at all early voting centers and to our absentee voters this fall.
early.notes: Winners as listed: 'K-5 Winner Emmeline S.', '6-8 Winner Adalyn D.', '9-12 Winner Katherine C.' Students, so first names only; surname initials removed. Read 2026-10-28.

more.en: Emmeline, Adalyn and Katherine drew the three winning designs in the county's fourth student sticker contest, picked with nearly 4,200 votes. One uses the colors of Rainbow Row. They are printed in a limited run and handed out during early voting, through October 31.
more.es: Emmeline, Adalyn y Katherine dibujaron los tres diseños ganadores del cuarto concurso de stickers para estudiantes del condado, elegidos con casi 4,200 votos. Uno usa los colores de Rainbow Row. Se imprimen en cantidad limitada y se reparten durante la votación anticipada, hasta el 31 de octubre.
more.en_after: Emmeline, Adalyn and Katherine drew the three winning designs in the county's fourth student sticker contest, picked with nearly 4,200 votes. One uses the colors of Rainbow Row. They were printed in a limited run and handed out during early voting in 2026.
more.es_after: Emmeline, Adalyn y Katherine dibujaron los tres diseños ganadores del cuarto concurso de stickers para estudiantes del condado, elegidos con casi 4,200 votos. Uno usa los colores de Rainbow Row. Se imprimieron en cantidad limitada y se repartieron durante la votación anticipada de 2026.
more.quote: The designs will be printed on a limited run and distributed during the early voting period for the 2026 General Election.
more.notes: Board of Voter Registration and Elections fall newsletter PDF, p. 4, read with pdftotext. First name and last initial on the page.

provisional.en: You vote one if you forgot your photo ID, or if you can't get one and sign a reasonable impediment affidavit. If you forgot it, show your ID at the county office before certification. County boards decide which provisional ballots count on the Friday after the election.
provisional.es: Votas con una si se te olvidó tu identificación con foto, o si no puedes conseguir una y firmas una declaración de impedimento razonable. Si se te olvidó, muestra tu identificación en la oficina del condado antes de la certificación. Las juntas de los condados deciden qué boletas provisionales se cuentan el viernes después de la elección.
provisional.quote: On Friday following the election, county election boards determine which provisional ballots to count, and those votes are added to the totals.

line.en: You can still vote. Anyone in line at 7 p.m. on Election Day will be allowed to vote.
line.es: Todavía puedes votar. Cualquier persona que esté en la fila a las 7 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones podrá votar.
line.quote: Anyone in line at 7:00 p.m. will be allowed to vote.

track.en: Check the status of your absentee request and track your ballot online at scVOTES.gov, or call your county voter registration office.
track.es: Revisa el estado de tu solicitud de voto en ausencia y sigue tu boleta en línea en scVOTES.gov, o llama a la oficina de registro de votantes de tu condado.
track.quote: Check the status of your absentee request and track your ballot online or contact your county voter registration office.

late_mail.en: Mailing now is risky. Your county office must receive it by 7 p.m. on November 3, and a postmark doesn't count. The Election Commission says to consider returning it in person this week. You can also vote a provisional ballot in person, and it counts as long as your absentee ballot isn't returned before the polls close.
late_mail.es: Mandarla por correo ahora es arriesgado. La oficina de tu condado debe recibirla a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del 3 de noviembre, y el matasellos no cuenta. La Comisión Electoral recomienda considerar devolverla en persona esta semana. También puedes votar en persona con una boleta provisional, y cuenta siempre que tu boleta de voto en ausencia no se devuelva antes de que cierren los lugares de votación.
late_mail.quote: You may also vote a provisional ballot in person that will count as long as your absentee ballot is not returned before the polls close on Election Day.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on scvotes.gov by curl (Early Voting, Prep for the 2026 Statewide General Election, Absentee Voting, Photo ID Requirements, General FAQs, How to Vote), the 2026 Voter and Absentee Go-To Guides (PDFs, September 2026), and S.C. Code Title 7 Chapter 13 on scstatehouse.gov (not cited in a fact). South Carolina is already verified in states.js (October 19 to 31, closed Sunday, October 25); the early voting page still says 'Early Voting for 2026 Statewide General Election are Monday, October 19 - Saturday, October 31.' and 'Closed Sunday, October 25'. CONFLICT on early voting hours: see dates.early_hours notes (6 p.m. in the 2026 lines, guides and statute; 5 p.m. in the page's general schedule table). Mail request date: the absentee page says '5:00 p.m. on the 11th day prior to the election'; the 2026 Absentee Go-To Guide gives Friday, October 23. Registration also closed by mail (postmarked) on October 5 and in person at most offices at 5 p.m. October 2. Campaign rules: the FAQ covers literature, signs and posters within 500 feet and candidate badges, but not voters' clothing, so gear doesn't tell voters what to wear. Drop boxes are not mentioned anywhere; in-person return is to the county office or an early voting center, with photo ID.

hours.en: Polling places are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: The polls must be opened at seven o'clock a.m. and closed at seven o'clock p.m. the day of election and must be held open during these hours without intermission or adjournment.
